hook: Your microwave door is full of tiny holes for a reason.
title: Your microwave door is a cage for waves
description: The metal mesh on your microwave door has holes smaller than the microwaves, so they cannot get out. Light waves are far smaller, so you can still see your food. Look at your door and you can see it right now.
comment_prompt: Did you know this? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your microwave door is full of tiny holes.
scenes.headline: Look At The Door

scenes.narration: That metal mesh blocks the microwaves.
scenes.headline: A Metal Shield

scenes.narration: Microwaves are about twelve centimetres long.
scenes.headline: 12 cm Waves

scenes.narration: The holes are much smaller than that.
scenes.headline: Holes Are Tiny

scenes.narration: Light waves are far tinier still.
scenes.headline: Light Is Tinier

scenes.narration: So light passes through and you see the food.
scenes.headline: You See Your Food

scenes.narration: Your door is a cage for waves.
scenes.headline: Cage For Waves

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: the strip holding India's map together.
scenes.headline: Up Next
